supersedes: resolution-plan.json execution budget only; original sealed packet remains unchanged

tools.selection_note: Root must select this explicitly recorded local Hex 2.5.1 operation before release. No Hex installation or toolchain change is proposed; remote CI keeps its existing configuration. Static identities are bound in preparation-receipt.json and runtime version output remains pending.

command_budget: Every command uses only the time remaining before the one absolute work cutoff at40s. There is no180s command,300s operation, automatic retry, fallback or broader unlock.
process_custody: One new session/group per command. Preserve the original direct child unreaped via waitid(WNOWAIT), so group signals cannot hit a reused leader identity. Send TERM then KILL only while unreaped and custody confirmed. Reap original child, then only observe group absence. No global process inventory. Unknown closure keeps scratch and fails.
disk_growth: Check only the marked private scratch tree at launch/read checkpoints and normally every100ms while a command runs; stop on size, entry or symlink refusal. This guard is not a VM memory guarantee.
retained_outputs: One attempt folder with bounded command logs, actual-mix.lock when all groups are closed, verified lock-inventory.json when full resolution succeeds, and receipt.json recording all failures/cleanup. No canonical edits or shared cache/dependency/build use.
lock_acceptance: Exactly21 original package names; actual Mix-generated bandit1.14.0 and jose1.11.13; their generated outer checksums agree with the official Hex candidate metadata in the immutable review; each other complete entry SHA256 and metadata unchanged. Store all21 entries plus explicit19 before/after hash pairs. Offline--check-locked must preserve the resolved lock bytes.
trust: Private copied hash-bound installed Hex2.5.1 archive, private Mix/Hex state, sanitized environment, signed registry/HTTPS/origin checks enabled. No local.hex, deps.update, product compile/tests/start, DB/provider/OpenSSL CLI, native/UI/capture or canonical mutation.
qualification_boundary: Existing full remote690-test Phoenix CI remains the later canonical validation path. The two proposed HTTP/2 wire cases are separately pending and are not run or newly accepted by this resolution.
deadline_limit: Cutoffs are checked with monotonic time inside controller loops and per-file operations; OS process creation/filesystem syscalls are not an OS-enforced real-time sandbox. A phase overrun is a failure. Never delete scratch or claim closure when it cannot be verified within the reserved phase.
